title: Shutdown resource-retention warning with shared script defaults, self-cast and static Dictionary read
body:
### Tested versions

Official Windows x64 console builds:
- 4.6.2.stable.official.71f334935: 20/20 baseline warnings
- 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf: 10/10 baseline warnings
Regression boundary unknown.

### System information

Windows build 10.0.26200.0; official Windows x64 console binaries. Normal headless Main scene (dummy renderer); Compatibility configured. No rendering content, plugins or autoloads.

### Issue description

See A10_RESULTS.md for the full strict-control matrix and explicit
identity/supporting qualifications. README.md documents preparation commands.

Official Windows console binaries: 4.6.2.stable.official.71f334935 and
4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf. Normal headless Main scene, no rendering content.

Extract the A10 candidate, run `./Prepare.ps1 baseline`, then start a NEW Godot
process with `godot --headless --path . --verbose -- fail`.
Expected: normal shutdown without resource-retention diagnostics.
Actual: Helper.gd reported still in use; 20/20 on 4.6.2 and 10/10 on 4.7.2.
All runs exit zero, with no parser errors or observed crashes.

Main loads Helper and two scripts, clears its resource array, nulls its local
Helper and quits. No participant instances are created; no custom cache mode,
manual frees or orphan gameplay nodes. The retaining engine reference is unknown.

At identical paths/names, replacing only the unused self-cast target or only
the helper's unused static-variable read clears the warning. Const and unused
method-local preload storage also clear it. All controls repeat 10 times on
4.6.2 and five on 4.7.2. See matrix for all helper subcontrols. Area2D inheritance
is not necessary: Node and RefCounted reproduce. Separate dependency identity
clears the warning but is explicitly an identity control, not a same-reference
control. C2 changes both variable and method staticness and is supporting only.

No unbounded memory growth, engine ownership cause or production workaround
is established. This is a shutdown resource-retention warning report only.
Possibly related #122022 and #118528 are compared in A10_RESULTS.md; neither is
claimed as a duplicate. No lighting resources are involved.

## Strict-control matrix (counts are Helper warnings)

| Case | Type | Paths same | Only intended semantic change | 4.6.2 Helper warnings | 4.7.2 Helper warnings | Warning | Crash |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | reference | yes | unchanged | 20/20 | 10/10 | H | none |
| no_self_cast | STRICT | yes | cast FlowerSide -> Node, method retained | 0/10 | 0/5 | none | none |
| no_static_dictionary | STRICT state removal | yes | remove declaration and replace now-invalid read with literal Dictionary | 0/10 | 0/5 | none | none |
| instance_dictionary | SUPPORTING | yes | variable AND reader must become non-static | 0/10 | 0/5 | none | none |
| unused_static_dictionary | STRICT | yes | only return cache -> return {} | 0/10 | 0/5 | none | none |
| const_preload | STRICT storage | yes | both defaults var -> const | 0/10 | 0/5 | none | none |
| method_local_preload | STRICT storage | yes | both defaults moved to unused functions; scope/timing intentional | 0/10 | 0/5 | none | none |
| distinct_shared_identity | IDENTITY | no (one dependency) | identical resource at another path | 0/10 | 0/5 | none | none |
| shared_node | STRICT content | yes | Area2D -> Node | 10/10 | 5/5 | H | none |
| shared_refcounted | STRICT content | yes | Area2D -> RefCounted | 10/10 | 5/5 | H | none |

All class names are identical. H denotes the Helper.gd shutdown warning.
Fresh candidate extraction additionally passed baseline 3/3 warnings and four
strict controls each 3/3 clean.

Exact diagnostic:
```text
WARNING: ObjectDB instances leaked at exit (run with --verbose for details).
ERROR: 1 resources still in use at exit.
Resource still in use: res://Helper.gd (GDScript)
```

Possibly related: #122022 uses instantiation, self-referencing factories and unrelated typed upcasting; #118528 observes preload retention after scene-instance removal. Neither is a confirmed duplicate.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Extract the attached ZIP and close any Godot process using it.
2. In PowerShell run ./Prepare.ps1 baseline.
3. After preparation finishes, start a fresh process: godot --headless --path . --verbose -- fail
4. Observe the Helper.gd shutdown warning. Capture stdout AND stderr; exit code is zero.
5. Run ./Prepare.ps1 no_self_cast and repeat the exact same Godot command in a fresh process: warning absent.
6. README.md and A10_RESULTS.md document all controls and RunMatrix.ps1. Always use -- fail after preparing each case; do not use historical routing modes. No hot reload, cache deletion or concurrent tests.
Same project path, participant filenames/class names, Main, load order and shutdown sequence for every case. The identity control intentionally changes one dependency reference.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[ScriptLifetimeRepro_A10.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32696402/ScriptLifetimeRepro_A10.zip)
